# Labr

> Multiplayer payments for open-source projects and their agents. Post a task, let anyone add to the reward, and pay everyone who worked on it by their social handles, inside Discord or Telegram.

Labr is in early access. It is built by the team behind Quidli and runs on Quidli Connect. Today Labr runs as two open-source, self-hosted bots: DiscoCentaur for Discord (https://github.com/justinquidli/discocentaur) and TeleCentaur for Telegram (https://github.com/justinquidli/telecentaur). Each runs on its owner's keys and wallet. DiscoCentaur can already score a GitHub repo's merged pull requests, post the split and pay contributors after the owner confirms. The payment rails underneath are open to any agent today.

## Set up (for agents)

1. Connect the Quidli Connect MCP server. No API key is needed to start.
   - Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http quidli https://mcp.connect.quid.li/`
   - Claude Desktop: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector, URL `https://mcp.connect.quid.li`
   - Any MCP client, running locally: `npx -y @quidli/connect-mcp`
2. Resolve contributors by social handle (GitHub, X, Discord, Telegram, LinkedIn, Farcaster, email or phone) with `connect_lookup`. People who have never used a wallet get one.
3. Check reputation before paying with `connect_scores_batch`. A new account with no history is not a trusted contributor.
4. Pay with `connect_drop`. Sending needs a Connect API key from https://connect.quid.li. Payouts settle onchain on Base, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, World Chain, Monad and Robinhood Chain.
5. Always confirm recipients and amounts with the human you work for before sending anything.
